reviews.t: Perfect for Bell’s Palsy symptoms of the eye
reviews.x: This is great to keep moisture in the eye that doesn’t blink. I can wear it under my prescription glasses. I wear it while sleeping rather than the suggestions to tape your eye shut. I don’t have to wear it all day but it sure brings comfort when needed. I’ve been using it for four weeks now as of March 1st. My palsy started Feb 1st. Slowly improving. At night I put in drops and Refresh PM dry eye ointment and then put on this patch. Keeps the eye safe while sleeping.

reviews.t: Should be better for the price
reviews.x: Worked for what I needed but didn't last long at all. The foam that cushions the cover became discolored and came apart within weeks. The elastic that goes around your head also loosens fast. Then the patch doesn't stay put anymore. I'm coming out of brain surgery so I can't feel it's placement or shift because half my face is still numb. I find it's constantly shifted dangerous close to rubbing in my eye.

reviews.t: Great for Bells Palsy
reviews.x: After having been diagnosed with Bell's Palsy, I was so happy to find this product to deal with my non-stop-watering right eye.  My eye wouldn't blink, so it was constantly tearing.  This "patch" allows me to keep the eye moist so that it doesn't have to create tears to keep the eye moist.  It does fog up, but this is to be expected.  The string stretched out after a couple days but I just tied a knot in it.  If you get the BP diagnosis and have the eye problem, get this right away!

reviews.t: It works but could be improved
reviews.x: It works well if you have bells palsy and and eye that does not close. Being able to see out of a covered eye is so much better than the old solid "Pirate Patch" over the eye. What is not good is the thin wire elastic strap. Wear more than several hours leaves a temp impression on forehead. No big deal but the strap should be flat for better and longer comfort. That said it I use it daily. Fix the strap issue and I would buy several more  even if they cost more.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for relieving eye discomfort and keeping the eye moist and protected during Bell's palsy or similar facial paralysis.
Many users highlight that it allows them to maintain vision and wear glasses over the patch while protecting the eye.
Some reviewers note the materials feel cheap or thin and that the product does not last long, with foam separating and the band losing elasticity.
A few reviewers mention the chamber fogs up from trapped moisture, which can make it hard to see through.
Sizing can be an issue, with at least one reviewer finding the small size too small and recommending care when ordering.
